title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
EE Merthyr Tydfil Contact Centre - Full-time role - 37.5 Hours per week

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Merthyr is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Merthyr contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Part-time Finance Assistant Legal Sector
description:
Our client, a respected law firm, is seeking a Finance Assistant (Legal Sector) to support their busy finance function. This part-time role is ideal for someone with solid legal accounts experience who enjoys working with accuracy, pace and responsibility.

This is a part-time vacancy, ideally working 5 days/week, Monday to Friday 9:30 - 2:30. Perfect for those with young children, and need to be there for the school runs.

Key Responsibilities
- Daily finance tasks including cashbook updates and accurate posting of client/office transactions
- Regulated payments including Faster Payments, CHAPS, SDLT and HMLR financial activity
- Reconciliations including client/office reconciliations and full three-way reconciliation cycles
- Conveyancing finance support for completions, transfers and property-related financial workflows
- Financial reporting producing routine management reports and maintaining internal finance records
- Purchase ledger processing invoices and supporting supplier relationships
- Payroll & year-end assisting with payroll runs, audits and annual accounts preparation
- Systems & compliance maintaining Xero and case management data while supporting SRA compliance

What We're Looking For
- 2-3 years' experience in legal accounts or finance within a law firm
- Strong understanding of legal accounting procedures and SRA Accounts Rules
- Confident using Xero or similar accounting software
- Experience with legal case management systems (Clio, Hoowla, etc.)
- Highly organised, detail-driven and able to manage multiple priorities
- Strong communication skills and a professional, trustworthy approach
- Excellent numerical and analytical ability
- Solid IT skills, including Microsoft Excel

Desirable
- AAT qualification (or qualified by experience)
- Experience in conveyancing finance

Apply now or contact Luke at Brook Street Cardiff

Brook Street NMR is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Receptionist
description: Talbot Green Group Practice are looking to recruit a full time receptionists to work within our friendly and organised team. We are a busy practice with 12,500 patients. Computer literacy skills are essential, preferably with previous experience in primary care. The successful candidates must be well organized, with excellent communication skills to deal with people in a polite and sensitive manner, and have the ability to work as part of a team.You will be part of our front of house team who are the first contact for our patients as well as undertaking daily administration tasks and responsibilities. This is a varied, rewarding and challenging role, which will suit people who are highly motivated and can cope with a demanding environment and lots of patient contact both face to face and on the telephone. You will also be expected to work in our branch surgery in Beddau so own transport is essential. The successful candidates must be well organized, with excellent communication skills to deal with people in a polite and sensitive manner, and have the ability to work as part of a team. Talbot Green Group Practice's team comprises of 5 GP Partners, 8 GP's, 3 Practice Nurses, 2 HCAs and is supported by a highly effective and friendly admin and reception team. We also have a branch surgery in Beddau. This post benefits from a generous NHS Pensions Job description You will be part of our front of house team who are the first contact for our patients as well as undertaking daily administration tasks and responsibilities. This is a varied, rewarding and challenging role, which will suit people who are highly motivated and can cope with a demanding environment and lots of patient contact both face to face and on the telephone. You will also be expected to work in our branch surgery in Beddau so own transport is essential. Hours: We have a post for a Full time 37 hours contracted weekly but (possible overtime available) between 8am and 6.30pm Monday to Friday. Must be flexible to cover for colleagues during holidays, sickness and to cover extra hours. CV and cover letter must be sent to Practice.manager.w95036@wales.nhs.uk to be considered.

title: Receptionist Administrator
location: Pontypridd, CF37 2AA, Pontypridd, CF38 1PN, Pontypridd, CF37 3DU
description: Why Join Us? This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic team at our busy town centre practice. You'll be the welcoming face of our surgery, providing essential support to patients and ensuring their healthcare journey is as smooth as possible. Heres why youll love working with us: Work-Life Balance: Monday to Friday shifts with no weekend work. Excellent Benefits Package: Including NHS pension, generous annual leave allowance, free flu jabs, uniform, and sick pay. Career Development: Were a training practice, committed to education and supporting your professional growth. Friendly Environment: Be part of a collaborative and compassionate team. What Youll Be Doing Be the first point of contact for patients both in person and over the phone. Manage appointments, process repeat prescriptions and provide general administrative support. Accurately update and maintain patient records. Collaborate with colleagues across our main and branch surgeries to deliver high-quality service. Handle queries and navigate care for patients with empathy and professionalism. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Provide exceptional service to our patients at the reception desk, updating computer on patients arrival and dealing with a range of routine queries including prescription requests. Problem-solve issues within competency (with senior staff always available for support). Concentration is required to deal with patients' requests and there is occasional exposure to difficult/demanding situations. Prepare consulting rooms replenishing stationery and ensuring rooms are neat and tidy. First point of contact for patients who telephone, managing appointments, dealing with routine queries, giving results etc where more senior staff are always available. Retrieve, scan and file medical records as required ensuring accuracy. Daily allocating of pathology results to appropriate GP and contacting patients as per protocol. Preparing files for all new patients. Updating practice systems with data gathered from a variety of sources e.g hospital letters, through scanning, electronic links and Cervical Screening Wales ensuring accuracy. Processing routine requests for repeat prescriptions with guidance from office manager as per protocol ensuring accuracy. Monitor registration links in accordance with practice protocol. Demonstrate duties to new staff. Participate in the development of protocols through contribution to staff meetings. Summarising of clinical records under supervision of office manager ensuring accuracy. Accept responsibility for own development and update PDP as appropriate. Liaise with and support all members of the primary care team. Alert the Management Team to issues of quality and risk.
